{{Quote|You took my hand. Shamed me. Now I kill you.|Bok to [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Siege of Saleucami">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Siege of Saleucami]]''</ref>}}
'''Bok''' was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Morgukai]] warrior from [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]].

==Biography==
In [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], he, his father [[Tsyr]], and [[Kh'aris Fenn]] were used by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] in his plan to stage a coup on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. During a battle with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], he lost his arm and feigned his death. He had his hand replaced with a cybernetic one.

A decade later, Count Dooku invited Bok to be the source of genetic material for a clone army of Morgukai. The Count promised that the Morgukai would be resurrected on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] and trained by [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]]; Bok accepted. Unfortunately for his cause, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] got wind of the army and sent three [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]] to avert the growing threat that Saleucami now posed.

Bok saw his chance for revenge when he spotted Aayla Secura during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. His [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] gauntlet rendered her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] useless. However, when he engaged her in hand-to-hand combat, she quickly bested him without breaking a sweat, despite being a third his size. Exhausted and humiliated, Bok tried again and again to fell the Twi'lek Jedi, each time being beaten down by powerful kicks and blows. Aayla retorted that he had disappointed his father's ghost. Bok became furious that the Jedi insulted him and charged, but Aayla [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-pushed]] Bok against a laser gate, killing him.
